item.title: Scheduled Caste Status Ends After Conversion From Hinduism, Sikhism, Or Buddhism To Other Religions: Supreme Court - Northeast Today
item.description: The Supreme Court has clarified that only individuals belonging to the Hindu, Sikh, or Buddhist faiths are eligible to claim Scheduled Caste (SC) status. item.title: Sikkim: Seized Drugs Destroyed At Namchi District Hospital - Northeast Today
item.description: Namchi, March 24: The District Level Drug Disposal Committee carried out the destruction of seized controlled and contraband substances at District Hospital, Namchi, on Tuesday, following approval from the Ld. District & Sessions Court, Namchi. The drugs, seized during operations from 2018 to 2025, were associated with 23 SADA cases whose trial proceedings have concluded.
